Fleet posture is attention. 5 of 7 hosts report healthy status; 2 hosts show warning indicators. No critical states detected. Overall fleet status reflects elevated memory utilization on two hosts rather than systemic degradation.

NOTABLE HOST EXCEPTIONS

system-host-2: Memory utilization at 70.3% (warning threshold). Moderate workload footprint (8 containers, 2 pods, 3 VMs).

RISKS AND ITEMS TO WATCH

Memory pressure concentration on ray-macbook presents the clearest near-term risk. High utilization on a laptop-class host with thermal indicators suggests potential throttling or OOM conditions under load. No confirmed service impact at this time.

system-host-2's elevated memory warrants monitoring but remains below critical thresholds.

RECOMMENDED ACTIONS

1. Investigate memory utilization is high at 88.7% on ray-macbook. Verify whether this reflects expected workload, memory leak, or misconfiguration. Assess thermal management given concurrent Warm temperature indication.

2. No immediate corrective action required for system-host-2; continue monitoring memory trend.

DATA CONFIDENCE

Level: limited. Limitations: Some metrics are unavailable. The supplied evidence does not specify which metrics are missing or from which hosts. Current assessments rely on complete telemetry from 7 hosts; gaps may exist in underlying sensor coverage.
